description: Held-out v3 evaluation set for the design-engineering skill: 312 realistic developer prompts with structured expectations (scope, modes, platform, ontology concepts, preservation constraints). Authored blind by an independent subagent that saw only ONTOLOGY.md and the generation brief - no access to the skill, its lexicon, scripts, or any prior eval case. Distribution follows the brief with a proportional +12 uplift over the 300-case floor to clear the 310 minimum: 62 create (30 of them modifications to an existing app), 62 refactor/polish, 52 audit/accessibility, 42 platform-specific native (TV, set-top, kiosk, WinUI/WPF/Avalonia desktop, Flutter/SwiftUI/Compose mobile), 32 brand/design-system, 32 ambiguous-but-in-scope UI symptoms, 30 out-of-scope abstain prompts. The abstain block was kept at exactly 30 so the uplift does not inflate the negative class.
